remarks: This custom-built estate offers an exceptional opportunity to own a new home in one of the most coveted pockets of the Tree Section, just steps from Sand Dunes Park. Thoughtfully designed on a 5,205-square-foot lot, this 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom residence makes a striking architectural statement, blending natural stone and crisp lap siding beneath contrasting black-trimmed rooflines. A gabled stone façade anchored by a dramatic round window pairs seamlessly with a sleek, modern wing, creating a home that feels both timeless and distinctly current.
